python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QWidget
python.setup:
root_layout = QVBoxLayout(%PARENT%)
root_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
shell = fluentqt.Card(%PARENT%)
root_layout.addWidget(shell)
shell_layout = QVBoxLayout(shell)
shell_layout.setContentsMargins(1, 1, 1, 1)
shell_layout.setSpacing(0)
control = fluentqt.TitleBar(shell)
content = QWidget(control)
layout = QHBoxLayout(content)
layout.setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0)
layout.setSpacing(8)
icon = fluentqt.FontIcon(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Home, content)
icon.setIconSize(14)
layout.addWidget(icon)
title = fluentqt.Label("Fluent Studio", content)
title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
layout.addWidget(title)
tag = fluentqt.Label("Workspace", content)
tag.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
tag.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(tag)
layout.addStretch(1)
share = fluentqt.Button("Share", content)
share.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Subtle)
share.setFluentSize(fluentqt.Button.ButtonSize.Small)
share.setFixedHeight(26)
layout.addWidget(share)
control.setContentWidget(content)
shell_layout.addWidget(control)
shell_layout.addWidget(fluentqt.Divider(shell))
body = QWidget(shell)
body_layout = QVBoxLayout(body)
body_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 16, 14)
body_layout.setSpacing(4)
heading = fluentqt.Label("Title bar safe region", body)
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
body_layout.addWidget(heading)
hint = fluentqt.Label("Adjust height or leading/trailing reserved widths to clear system window controls.", body)
hint.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
hint.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
hint.setWordWrap(True)
body_layout.addWidget(hint)
body_layout.addStretch(1)
shell_layout.addWidget(body, 1)

effectHint.en: Reserves leading width on the left edge (e.g. macOS traffic lights), shifting title bar content right.
effectHint.zh: 在左端预留系统安全宽度（如 macOS 红绿灯区），内部控件会自动右移避让。

effectHint.en: Reserves trailing width on the right edge (e.g. Windows caption buttons), keeping Share clear.
effectHint.zh: 在右端预留系统安全宽度（如 Windows 最小化/关闭按钮区），右侧操作按钮会自动左移避让。
